citation: Van et al. (2022). Zoning the suitability of the western Mekong Delta for paddy rice cultivation and aquaculture under current and future environmental conditions. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 194, 767.
study_question: paddy rice + shrimp suitability zoning, current vs future salinity/water scenarios
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: Same crop (rice) and zoning purpose; single specification. This study adds threshold sweep and reference decomposition.

citation: Ojara et al. (2021). Projected changes in East African climate and its impacts on climatic suitability of maize production areas by the mid-twenty-first century. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 193, 831.
study_question: climatic suitability of maize areas in East Africa 1970-2000 vs 2041-2060
new_field_observations: no (presence points; no new field data stated)
independent_validation: model diagnostics only (no independent field validation stated)
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: WorldClim climatic suitability; single threshold set. This study shows threshold-reference construction dominates.

citation: Bazkiaee et al. (2024). Multi-criteria GIS-based land suitability analysis for rice cultivation: a case study in Guilan Province, Iran. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 196, 680.
study_question: rice land suitability (AHP weighted overlay) in Guilan
new_field_observations: implied (soil nutrient attributes); not explicit in abstract
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: Rice GIS-AHP; no sensitivity to reference. This study quantifies reference-dependent instability.

citation: Mohamed et al. (2019). Land suitability modeling for newly reclaimed area using GIS-based multi-criteria decision analysis. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 191, 535.
study_question: new GIS-MCDA model vs parametric square-root method for wheat on reclaimed land
independent_validation: yes: correlation with actual yield (r=0.95 vs 0.46)
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: Validates against yield; new model claimed. This study has no yield validation (limitation) but audits reference independence.

citation: Azadi et al. (2023). Land evaluation approaches comparing TOPSIS and SAW with parametric methods for rice cultivation. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 195, 1296.
study_question: TOPSIS and SAW vs parametric methods for rice land evaluation
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: Rice method comparison with field pedons. This study compares reference constructions, not MCDA rules.

citation: Wang et al. (2024). Response of the cultivation suitability of Pu'er tea (Camellia sinensis var. assamica) to climate conditions and change in China. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 196, 371.
study_question: Pu'er tea cultivation suitability response to climate 1961-2020
independent_validation: partial: consistency with actual production checked (mismatch found)
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: Presence-point suitability with production consistency check. Analogous coverage check; this study audits same-product circularity.

citation: Benti et al. (2022). Modeling coffee (Coffea arabica L.) climate suitability under current and future scenario in Jimma zone, Ethiopia. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 194, 271.
study_question: coffee climate suitability current vs RCP scenarios
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: Field presence points + MaxEnt. This study has no field presence data (limitation).

citation: Vahidi et al. (2023). Fuzzy-based models’ performance on qualitative and quantitative land suitability evaluation for cotton cultivation in Sarayan County, South Khorasan Province, Iran. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 195, 488.
study_question: fuzzy, fuzzy-AHP, fuzzy-ANP comparison for cotton suitability
independent_validation: yes: r2, RMSE, GMER, MAPE vs actual production
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: Fuzzy model comparison with production validation. Comparable comparison logic; different object (reference vs rule).

citation: Rashidi & Sharifian (2022). A comparative analysis of three multi-criteria decision-making methods for land suitability assessment. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 194, 657.
study_question: AHP vs fuzzy AHP + TOPSIS for afforestation suitability
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: MCDM rule comparison. This study varies the threshold reference, holding rules fixed.

citation: Shaw et al. (2025). Assessment of probable zones of agricultural land suitability based on MCDM, probabilistic, and data-driven approach in Krishna District, India. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 197, 339.
study_question: AHP, FR, SE, EBF for agricultural land suitability
independent_validation: yes: ROC and SCAI with 70/30 well split
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: ROC with well split. This study explicitly declines ROC for lack of negatives.

citation: Waldron et al. (2020). Assessing water distribution and agricultural expansion in the Cele Oasis, China. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 192, 288.
study_question: water availability vs agricultural expansion of an oasis
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: Water vs agricultural expansion. Analogous non-compensatory water constraint; this study uses infrastructure only.

citation: Bagwan & Gavali (2024). Does spatial resolution matter in the estimation of average annual soil loss by using RUSLE?—a study of the Urmodi River Watershed (Maharashtra), India. Environmental Monitoring and Assessment, 196, 167.
study_question: effect of spatial resolution (30 m vs 10 m) on RUSLE soil loss
incremental_evidence_of_this_study: Spatial-resolution effect on RUSLE. Analogous support test; this study finds support effect small relative to reference.
